_comment: Example Alexa+ MCP add-on manifest. We cannot deploy an add-on for the hackathon; this documents the shape and respects the B6 limits (name <=30, short description <=123, 3-4 example phrases, icons at 72/64/88/126/180/241 px). URLs point at the deployed Function URL (PUBLIC_BASE_URL).
name: THREAD
shortDescription: Keeps shared household commitments on track: when something changes, it finds what's affected and who should act.
longDescription: THREAD is the coordination layer between intent and resolution. When a plan changes, it finds every affected commitment, moves responsibility to the right person, shares only the necessary context, and stays with the commitment until evidence shows it is actually done.
examplePhrases: Ask Sam to take Leo's tournament.
